title: LumaReader embed v1 options
description: Same Reader UI, up to three Markdown files. The host owns persistence. UI flags are not backend authorization.

mode.description: direct: visual editing; source: Markdown editing; preview: reading first, Edit remains available unless readOnly.

readOnly.description: Prevent document text and title editing.

sourcePreview.description: Start source editing with comparison preview.

sidebar.description: Allow opening the existing file/outline sidebar; initially collapsed.

modeSwitch.description: Show the Show Markdown toggle, allowing direct/source switching.

rename.description: Allow filename editing, preserving .md and the host document ID.

formatting.description: Show format insertion and table controls; this does not restrict which Markdown may be entered.

share.description: Show public Markdown sharing. Disable for private content workflows.

settings.description: Show Reader appearance and language settings.

language.description: Allow visitors to select another interface language in settings.

annotations.description: Enable native text annotations in direct mode. Off by default; locks the source-mode switch off. Text readOnly and annotationReadOnly are independent.

expand.description: install.js only: show outer expand button.

download.description: install.js only: show outer .md download button.

language.description: Initial interface language, e.g. zh-Hant, zh-Hans, en or ja; overrides the visitor stored preference at mount.

toolbar.description: Initial checkbox values in embedded Settings, reset from host configuration at each mount. features:false still disallows a tool.

formatting.description: Initially check Formatting to show insertion/table controls.

share.description: Initially check Share Markdown to show the share button.

annotationReadOnly.description: Show existing annotations without allowing changes. Requires features.annotations.

selectionActions.description: Optional host actions. Omit to use built-in Highlight, Note and Image note; [] allows external SDK actions only. SDK onAction receives the stable selection snapshot.
